# Proper Dark

Proper Dark is a darker, color-accented interface with deeper backgrounds and richer contrast. The primary accent is carried into context menus, active files and tabs, the editor toolbar styling is revised, and the recorded description states that the theme is also usable in light mode.

![Proper Dark screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lukasbach/obsidian-proper-dark/HEAD/thumb.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Proper Dark"
    author: "lukasbach"
    repo:   "lukasbach/obsidian-proper-dark"
    slug:   "proper-dark"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/proper-dark"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/lukasbach/obsidian-proper-dark"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lukasbach/obsidian-proper-dark/HEAD/thumb.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Apply a darker, color-accented interface for Obsidian with deeper backgrounds and richer contrast. Add the primary accent to context menus, active files and tabs, and refine the editor toolbar styling; also usable in light mode."
}
```
